# SkyWork Borivali: Full Reference

SkyWork Borivali is a premium yet accessible coworking space for Mumbai's professionals, located on the 15th floor steps from Borivali railway station, with panoramic city views. The brand tagline is "Elevate Your Workday".

## The Space

Two identical setups on the same floor with twenty-six seats in all: eighteen dedicated desks across the open collaborative areas, and two four-seat private cabins for focused work and client calls. The workspace is air conditioned, with windows overlooking the city and the station.

SkyWork cares about member health as much as productivity: purified air (air purifiers throughout), purified water, a microwave and electric kettle for homemade meals, and deliberately no pantry. Members are encouraged to step out for real breaks at the cafes around the station and come back sharper.

## Pricing (last updated August 8, 2026)

- Virtual Meeting Pass: Rs 350 for 1-3 hours. Additional hour: Rs 100. For occasional meetings or a first taste of the space.
- Full Day Pass: Rs 600 per day. A full working day, no strings attached.
- Monthly: Rs 6,000 per month. Complete access to the open workspace. Best value.

Referral offer: refer someone who books a monthly membership and both people get Rs 500 off their next month.

## Amenities

- High-speed WiFi with backup connections, so calls and uploads never drop
- Ergonomic seating: premium chairs built for full working days
- Purified air and water: air purifiers and water purifiers throughout the air-conditioned space
- Kitchen facilities: microwave and electric kettle for homemade vegetarian meals and hot drinks
- Safety and security: 24/7 camera coverage and a fire extinguisher on site, with clear emergency procedures
- Quiet by design: a silent working space; virtual meetings at your desk are fine, phone calls happen in the passage near the lift

## Policies

- Food: strictly vegetarian-only workspace. Members may bring homemade vegetarian meals.
- Smoking and alcohol: strictly not allowed.
- Calls: the workspace stays silent. Virtual meetings with headphones at your desk are fine; for voice calls, use the passage near the lift.
- Parking: none at the workspace itself. Public parking near Borivali railway station is available. The train remains the easiest way in.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do you have a pantry or cafeteria?
A: Deliberately, no. Long work hours need real breaks. Step out for chai at the cafes around the station, stretch, and come back sharper. We provide a microwave, an electric kettle, and purified water.

Q: Can I bring outside food?
A: Yes, bring your homemade vegetarian meals. The microwave and kettle are there for you. Please note: we strictly maintain a vegetarian-only policy in the workspace.

Q: Can I take phone calls in the workspace?
A: We keep the workspace silent. Virtual meetings with headphones at your desk are fine; for voice calls, please use the passage near the lift.

Q: Is smoking or drinking allowed?
A: No. SkyWork is a strictly no-smoking, no-alcohol workspace.

Q: Is parking available?
A: There is no parking at the workspace itself, but public parking near Borivali railway station is available and you can use that. Since we are steps from the station, the train remains the easiest way in.

Q: What health and safety measures do you have?
A: Air purifiers for clean air, water purifiers for safe hydration, 24/7 security cameras, ergonomic seating, and regular cleaning throughout the space. A fire extinguisher is installed on site with clear emergency procedures in place.

## Reviews

SkyWork Borivali has 20 five-star reviews on Google from professionals, students, day traders, chartered accountants, startups, and small businesses. Members highlight the stable WiFi with backup connections, the station-adjacent location, the clean air, the ergonomic chairs, the 15th-floor views, and the supportive owner.
